meta.note: Customer-facing prices, exclusive of GST. Materials and spare parts billed separately unless the description says otherwise.
meta.confidence: indicative — calibrate against the local society rate card before any real deployment. Statutory wage floor still governs; see pricing-model.md.

modes.fixed: priceP + stdMinutes. Price shown before booking.
modes.fault: visitChargeP + fromP. Diagnose on site, then select fault codes. Show as 'From ₹X'.
modes.unit: ratePerUnitP + unit + minQty. Show as '₹X / sq ft'.
modes.quote: no price. CTA becomes 'Get Quote' — books a free survey.
modes.workshop: fromP + workshop fulfilment. Drop-off or pickup, not a home visit.
